permutation_controls.interpretation: P baseline depends on biological-subject matching; the P task relation is label-related but does not depend strongly on matching the same subject across sessions.

recommendation_reason: The final P contains a transferable class relation in all five folds, but biological-subject-matched baselines and above-chance subject-ID information remain. Explicitly factor shared task relation from stable context; do not generically amplify P.
limits: P selection uses TRAIN-label-informed erasure utility; task content is partly expected from the definition.
Random controls are rank-matched, not energy-matched; P centroid energy is about 7.3 times random on OUTER_DEVELOPMENT. Protected-specificity independent of energy is not established.
Intermediate PathFit P is a pathway to final P, not independent biological persistence.
